source_text.body:
Query the ATS and draft intakes and phone screens
A recruiter uses Claude connected to their ATS to answer queries, create job-specific manager intakes, and draft phone screens per job and candidate.
·
Nov 17, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
In the thread, a recruiter says they use AI to create job-specific intake questions for hiring managers and specific phone screens for each job and candidate. Their workflow is to upload the job description, record and transcribe intake and screening calls, then keep using the same chat to turn those materials plus manager feedback into a candidate profile, Boolean strings, screen summaries, and submission emails.
How it went
The recruiter says it works like an assistant and is especially helpful for brand-new roles or industries they do not usually recruit for. The post gives no hard results or metrics, only that AI asks more specific intake questions than they would have thought of.
Worth knowing
A key catch from the thread is to keep feeding the same chat with the JD, transcript, feedback, and resumes so the later phone screens and summaries stay grounded in the role context.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Using my connected ATS, answer this question: [e.g. which open roles have candidates stuck in screening for over 14 days]. Then for the role [job title], draft a hiring manager intake questionnaire and a phone screen script tailored to the job requirements and to [candidate name or profile]. You're done when I have the answer and both drafts; don't send anything or change any records in the ATS.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/recruiting/comments/1xxq1pf/how_are_yall_using_ai_to_help_with_your_workload
